extName.description: Extension name, also used as the panel heading and the toolbar tooltip.

extDescription.message: Adds Access-Control-Allow-Origin to whitelisted drives so the web client can read and decrypt the ciphertext.

popupSubtitle.message: Adds Access-Control-Allow-Origin to whitelisted drives so the web client can read the ciphertext.

unknownOrigin.message: Unknown (open this from the app page)

autoAddNote.message: Turning this on gives the extension access to all sites; only hosts on the list are rewritten.

statusMissed.message: The rule does not match — add the host again

errOpenOnAppPage.message: Open this extension from a Sakura Encryptor page before adding a host

errPermissionDenied.message: Access to the host or the page origin was not granted

errDomainInvalid.message: That is not a valid host name

errReadState.message: Could not read the saved state

pendingGranted.message: Access to $domain$ is already granted — just click "Add".

pendingDetected.message: Detected drive blocked by CORS: $domain$. Click "Add" and "Allow" in the prompt and it will be added automatically; the panel closing is normal. Then reload the page to decrypt.

statusNoAllSites.message: All-sites access was not granted; hosts are authorised one by one

statusKeepAuto.message: Per-domain access was not granted; auto mode stays on

statusAllSitesKept.message: Could not revoke all-sites access; auto mode stays on
